featured.headline: Finance Republicans kill bid to stop Trump IRS audit-immunity deal
featured.dek: Republican senators on the Finance Committee voted to block an amendment that would have prevented the Trump administration from granting IRS audit immunity, exposing how the party protects executive financial interests over taxpayer accountability.
